summary: American Homes 4 Rent filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1 billion at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of Class A common shares under a sales agreement with multiple agents and forward sellers. The filing details a continuous offering program with forward sale agreements, commissions up to 2.0%, and settlement options (physical, cash, or net share). This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
